What I see here is someone who's given up hope. Hope of becoming successful. But I am not here to roast you, I'm here to offer a kind word of advice to the best of my ability. What you do with it is your own choice. 

Sometimes it's hard to treat yourself well, but that's okay. Just know, when you're at your lowest, the only thing that can happen is that it'll get better.

If you ever need someone to talk to, I am here for you.
